description: Check, set or clear the app's public slug (the readable name in play.neblla.com/<slug>). `checkOnly: true` only tells whether it is valid and free. `slug: null` removes it (old slug links stop working). Changing it changes the public URL — confirm with the developer.

slug.description: Wanted slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes), or null to clear

name: neblla_set_slug
